entry.title: Boyana Church, brick arcades and stone annex

groundCutout.basis: Occupied mapped church rectangle plus reconstructed rounded apse; approaches, garden and external stair keep original ground. An additional ordinary eastern exterior photo shows the rounded brick apse and curved roof crown. The source map simplifies this as a rectangle: the added 1.45m apse projection and its 3.55m wall/4.05m roof are picture-led approximations, not surveyed map geometry. Only the owned parent is replaced; the added apse has its own occupied ground mask. Upper doorway back uses shared dark painted metal; triangle and quad brick UVs now use the same metric repeat.

buildingCutout.basis: Q276553 and named church way44890267/native35184416979099 establish the single owned building. Current standard PMTiles supplies the approximately 13.9 x 9.5m rectangular footprint; the older georeference has the same identity and long axis. Internal +X points east/slightly south toward the lower church; +Z south toward the photographed stair. Native east/up/south coordinates are baked with heading 0. Three construction volumes and local roof treatment are picture-led approximations from the mapped perimeter and photographs. Unrelated buildings remain independent.

terrainReference.basis: Original standard Protomaps20261020/Mapzen 201x201/6m terrain. Uncovered western approach gives datum 775.2697762814635m; working floor +0.15m. Boundary grades -1.404..-0.007m, closed foundation -1.554m. Native fit remains draft pending actual current inspection. No bespoke terrain research, flattening or altered source heights. Exact paving, steps and accessibility remain unverified.
